title: Recent progress in underground hydrogen storage

Hydrogen (H2) is a clean energy option. Underground H2 storage (UHS) allows large-scale, long-term storage, balancing seasonal supply and demand. This graphics explores recent UHS advances, ongoing challenges, and future research directions.
